scope.validity: standing authorization until explicitly revoked or narrowed

read: search, fetch, compare and reconcile repository objects, pull requests, manifests, receipts and active DAG state
read Dropbox backups, metadata, restore maps and synchronization receipts
read Jira issues, links, statuses and Confluence control-plane material
write: create non-force GitHub branches, governance files, manifests, receipts, issues, comments and Draft pull requests
create non-overwriting Dropbox folders and UTF-8 synchronization, manifest, receipt and restore-map files
create or update generated Atlassian synchronization pages and append Jira/Confluence reconciliation comments
synchronize: project GitHub formula and code authority into Dropbox durability records and Atlassian workflow/DAG projections
record cross-repository owner, consumer, dependency, stale, conflict and supersession states
perform bounded periodic and event-triggered reconciliation and produce fail-closed receipts

system_of_record.formula_code_and_exact_evidence: GitHub exact commit/tree/blob plus executable receipt
system_of_record.durable_recovery_copy: Dropbox non-overwriting snapshot plus restored replay receipt
system_of_record.reconciliation_rule: Atlassian and Dropbox never override GitHub formula truth

allowed_without_repeat_confirmation: stale, blocked, conflict and supersession projection
requires_new_explicit_confirmation: force push, branch rewrite or history replacement
delete, move, rename, restore or overwrite existing Dropbox content
public Dropbox sharing or audience/permission changes
Jira workflow transitions that change execution authorization
scientific claim promotion or blocker downgrade
automatic selection of a winner in a semantic formula conflict
production physics, tolerance or numerical-policy changes not already authorized by a bounded task

claim_boundary: This authorization changes governance capability only.
It does not establish formula equivalence, implementation parity, cross-repository compatibility or scientific validity.
Existing NO_PASS_RF04, NO_PASS_REC_PHYSICAL_SPLIT and NO_PASS_FIRST_CANONICAL_INTERVAL boundaries remain unchanged.
